instruction: Extract from Pets/Lucy Park Nov.pdf the invoice line items: date, start time, end time, billed duration, hourly rate if printed, and totals. Query: dog-walking visits billed.
List cameras (ug-surveillance cameras) and registered known faces (ug-surveillance faces identity-type known).
ug-document extract --file "Pets/Lucy Park Nov.pdf" --query "dog-walking visit line items" --schema "{items:[{date,start_time,end_time,billed_duration,amount}],hourly_rate,total}"
ug-surveillance event-timeline --start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00 --end-time 2026-11-06T23:59:59 --timezone America/New_York --camera-id "Front Door" --topic HumanFace --identity-type all --limit 200

ug-surveillance event-timeline --start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00 --end-time 2026-11-06T23:59:59 --timezone America/New_York --camera-id "Front Door" --topic HumanFace --identity-type known --person-name "Lucy Park" --limit 200
